sources.title: Chayka et al., Scientific Reports, 2020, geological setting
sources.facts: Kola SG-3 is described as 12,262 m deep. Its geological observations do not establish a 3D bore trajectory.

sources.title: Wrigley, 2023, drilling-history study
sources.facts: The historical discussion documents deviations, abandoned shafts and redrilling; a straight depth marker must not be described as a measured path.

sources.title: Desai et al. Science 2016, author-hosted paper and supplement

sources.title: Corning family specification 0396_EMEA_BEN, page 3, 2017-10-18
sources.facts: SMF-28 Ultra core 8.2, cladding 125, coating 242 micrometres. The 9.2 micrometre mode-field diameter at 1310 nm is a different quantity.

sources.title: Martin Kreutz, Paramecium caudatum microscopy observations
sources.facts: Diagnosis: 170-300 micrometre cells, rounded anterior/narrow posterior, oral groove widening toward anterior, 80-120 rows of paired cilia. Observed caudal cilia 10-20 micrometres. Fig. 3 shows a 250 micrometre cell; no photograph or outline is copied.

sources.title: Kitagawa, Sasagawa and Kitayama, 1995
sources.facts: Nephila clavata dragline diameter 2-5 micrometres; the exterior is described as featureless. A representative 3 micrometre diameter is already the catalog definition.
